selectABlock: Select a block to edit it
heading: Heading
textOnlyDescription: Email will be sent as plain text (no HTML)
syncLinkedCampaign: Linked to the campaign. Once saved, a change here applies to every linked email of this campaign. Click to unlink and give this email a value of its own.
syncLinkedOrganisation: Linked to the organisation. The value cannot be changed here. Click to unlink and give this email a value of its own.
syncUnlinkedCampaign: Not linked: this email has a value of its own. Click to link it to the campaign, the email then follows the campaign's setting.
syncUnlinkedOrganisation: Not linked: this email has a value of its own. Click to link it to the organisation, the email then follows the organisation's setting.
meetingButtonLabel: Button instead of the location line
meetingButtonFallback: The line with the location is still in the text and goes into the email whenever an appointment's location is not a link.
meetingButtonNotOnline: This campaign offers more than an online meeting. The email therefore always shows the line with the location, for an online appointment too.
meetingButtonNone: This email does not mention the appointment's location, so there is nothing to switch.
meetingButtonUnmanaged: This email holds the location in a way that cannot be switched here: inside a sentence, in an HTML block, or a button and a line side by side. Change it in the email itself.
locationLineHidden: The line with the location is not in the email while the meeting button shows.
